risks.risk: Whether it actually sews correctly (tension/feed/stitch quality), not just runs.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video sewing a straight line on fabric with top + bobbin thread visible and stitch consistency.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven for sewing performance (worst case: needs adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Motor/drive condition (smooth running claim not verifiable without a running clip).
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the machine running under pedal load with needle movement clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as motor/drive condition unknown (worst case: weak/noisy/intermittent).

risks.risk: Accessories/manual completeness (seller claims included, but not shown).
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos laid out of every accessory plus the original manual cover/pages.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as accessories/manual not confirmed (worst case: only machine + pedal/cable).

risks.risk: Hidden wear/damage not visible in the single wide shot (bobbin area, feed dogs, gears, needle bar).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of needle area, bobbin/bottom plate, feed dogs, and any visible drive/gear parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (worst case: may require parts/maintenance).

risks.proof: Ask for a photo of plug/pedal labels and a quick test showing stable power without sparking/overheating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical condition unknown (worst case: cable/pedal replacement needed).

proof_requests: Video: sewing a straight seam on fabric (top + bobbin thread visible) showing consistent stitches.
Video: pedal pressed with clear needle movement and stable operation (include sound).
Photos: all accessories laid out + original manual cover/page showing it matches the machine.
Close-ups: bobbin area/bottom plate, feed dogs, needle clamp/needle area, and any visible drive/gear parts.
Photo: plug and pedal label (if any) and a quick electrical test result.
response.reason: The seller’s reply asserts testing, but without new photos/videos it remains unverifiable remotely. The photo supports the machine identity, but not the key value drivers needed to price confidently (sewing performance, smooth running, and accessory/manual completeness).
